## Overview

Built a portfolio website on Wix to organize my project work in one place: case studies, creative projects, and professional work, in a format that's visually engaging and easy to navigate.

**View the live site:** [yafeiz.wixsite.com/yafei-zhang](https://yafeiz.wixsite.com/yafei-zhang){target="_blank"}

## Approach

- Designed the site architecture and layout to guide visitors through project narratives
- Applied visual hierarchy and typography (Libre Baskerville) to reinforce a professional, editorial aesthetic
- Built with responsive design principles to ensure usability across desktop and mobile devices

## Features

The site has dedicated sections for each project with context, visuals, and key takeaways. Layout uses grid and flexbox so it adapts across screen sizes, page navigation has smooth transition animations, and it supports browser zoom and accessible navigation patterns.
